blocks.en: A routine request has **three parts**: the **opening**, the **body** and the **close**. Use the **direct approach** (main idea first).
blocks.ms: Permintaan rutin ada **tiga bahagian**: **pembukaan**, **isi** dan **penutup**. Guna **pendekatan terus** (idea utama dahulu).

en: Part
What to do
Opening
State your request up front; pay attention to tone; assume audience compliance; be specific
ms: Nyatakan permintaan di awal; perhatikan nada; anggap audiens akan patuh; spesifik

en: Body
Smooth and logical explanation; show benefit to the reader; ask the most important question first; break down complex requests
ms: Penjelasan lancar dan logik; tunjuk manfaat kepada pembaca; tanya soalan paling penting dahulu; pecahkan permintaan kompleks

en: Close
Specific request and deadline; contact information; expression of appreciation
ms: Permintaan spesifik dan tarikh akhir; maklumat hubungan; ungkapan penghargaan

blocks.en: Memory hook: Ask first, explain, then act (deadline + thanks).
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: Minta dahulu, terangkan, kemudian tindakan (tarikh akhir + terima kasih).

en: Type
Key points
Asking for information and action
State the request clearly; support why you are making it; appeal to readers’ interests if applicable
ms: Nyatakan permintaan dengan jelas; sokong sebab; rayu kepada kepentingan pembaca jika sesuai

en: Asking for recommendations
Ask permission; use the direct approach; state the purpose of the recommendation; remind the reader how you know each other; close with appreciation
ms: Minta kebenaran; guna pendekatan terus; nyatakan tujuan syor; ingatkan bagaimana anda kenal; tutup dengan penghargaan

en: Making claims and requesting adjustments
Explain the problem and give details; provide backup information; request specific action
ms: Terangkan masalah dengan butiran; beri maklumat sokongan; minta tindakan spesifik

title.en: Strategy for Routine Replies and Positive Messages
title.ms: Strategi Balasan Rutin dan Mesej Positif

en: Part
What to do
Start with the main idea
Ask: what is the single most important message for the audience? Clear, concise opening; share good news first; prepare audience for the details
ms: Tanya: apakah mesej tunggal paling penting? Pembukaan jelas dan ringkas; kongsi berita baik dahulu; sediakan audiens untuk butiran

en: Provide details and explanation
Use the body to explain completely; use the indirect approach for negative info and only if it will elicit a positive response; provide assurance to the customer
ms: Guna isi untuk terangkan lengkap; guna pendekatan tidak terus untuk maklumat negatif dan hanya jika menghasilkan respons positif; beri jaminan kepada pelanggan

en: End with a courteous close
End on a neutral or positive note; a simple “thank you” may suffice; clearly communicate any follow-up action
ms: Tamat dengan nada neutral atau positif; “terima kasih” ringkas mungkin cukup; nyatakan jelas tindakan susulan

q.en: Three parts of a routine request?
Which approach is used for routine requests?

a.en: Direct approach: state the request up front.
a.ms: Pendekatan terus: nyatakan permintaan di awal.

q.en: Four tips for the opening of a routine request?

a.en: State request up front, pay attention to tone, assume compliance, be specific.
a.ms: Nyata permintaan di awal, perhatikan nada, anggap patuh, spesifik.

q.en: Four tips for the body of a routine request?

a.en: Smooth logical explanation, show benefit to reader, ask most important question first, break down complex requests.
a.ms: Penjelasan lancar logik, tunjuk manfaat, soalan paling penting dahulu, pecah permintaan kompleks.

q.en: Three elements of a courteous close?

a.en: Specific request and deadline, contact information, expression of appreciation.
a.ms: Permintaan spesifik dan tarikh akhir, maklumat hubungan, penghargaan.

q.en: Three common routine requests?

a.en: Asking for information and action; asking for recommendations; making claims and requesting adjustments.
a.ms: Minta maklumat dan tindakan; minta syor; membuat tuntutan dan minta pelarasan.

q.en: What do you do when asking for a recommendation?

a.en: Ask permission, use direct approach, state purpose, remind how you know each other, close with appreciation.
a.ms: Minta kebenaran, pendekatan terus, nyata tujuan, ingatkan hubungan, tutup dengan penghargaan.

q.en: Three parts of a claim message?

a.en: Explain the problem with details, provide backup information, request specific action.
a.ms: Terangkan masalah dengan butiran, beri maklumat sokongan, minta tindakan spesifik.

q.en: What question guides the opening of a routine reply?
q.ms: Soalan apa memandu pembukaan balasan rutin?

a.en: What is the single most important message I have for the audience?
a.ms: Apakah mesej tunggal paling penting untuk audiens?

q.en: When should negative information appear in the body of a reply?
q.ms: Bila maklumat negatif patut ada dalam isi balasan?

a.en: Only if it will elicit a positive response, using the indirect approach.
a.ms: Hanya jika ia menghasilkan respons positif, guna pendekatan tidak terus.

q.en: How should a routine reply close?

a.en: On a neutral or positive note, a simple thank you may suffice, state follow-up action.
a.ms: Nada neutral atau positif, terima kasih ringkas, nyatakan tindakan susulan.

q.en: Six types of routine replies and positive messages?
q.ms: Enam jenis balasan rutin dan mesej positif?

a.en: Answering requests; granting claims; recommendations; sharing routine information; announcing good news; fostering goodwill.
a.ms: Jawab permintaan; luluskan tuntutan; syor; kongsi maklumat rutin; umum berita baik; pupuk muhibah.

q.en: Three goals when answering requests?

a.en: Respond and answer all questions, leave a good impression, encourage the future sale.
a.ms: Balas dan jawab semua soalan, kesan baik, galak jualan akan datang.

q.en: Six steps for granting a claim?

a.en: Acknowledge, sympathise, take personal responsibility, explain resolution, repair relationship, follow up.
a.ms: Akui, bersimpati, tanggungjawab peribadi, terangkan penyelesaian, pulihkan hubungan, susulan.

q.en: Six elements of a recommendation letter?

a.en: Candidate’s full name, objective, relationship, relevant facts, comparison to peers, overall evaluation.
a.ms: Nama penuh, objektif, hubungan, fakta relevan, perbandingan rakan sebaya, penilaian keseluruhan.

q.en: Three steps for sharing routine information?

a.en: State purpose, provide necessary details, end with courteous close.
a.ms: Nyata tujuan, beri butiran, tamat sopan.

q.en: Three kinds of releases when announcing good news?

a.en: News releases, direct-to-consumer releases, social media releases.
a.ms: Siaran berita, siaran terus kepada pengguna, siaran media sosial.
